headline: CLE @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 2.56 at NYY 4.42, with a projected total of 6.98. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: CLE moved -0.23 runs while NYY moved +1.35, changing the projected margin by -1.58 runs. The projected total climbed +1.13, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cody Bellinger, Trent Grisham, Ben Rice, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Petey Halpin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
